package articles_test

import (
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	"github.com/goncini/goncini/webtest"

	"github.com/goncini/goncini/examples/realworld/app"
	"github.com/goncini/goncini/examples/realworld/config"
)

type userBody struct {
	User struct {
		Token string `json:"token"`
	} `json:"user"`
}

type commentBody struct {
	Comment struct {
		ID        int64     `json:"id"`
		Body      string    `json:"body"`
		CreatedAt time.Time `json:"createdAt"`
		UpdatedAt time.Time `json:"updatedAt"`
		Author    struct {
			Username string `json:"username"`
		} `json:"author"`
	} `json:"comment"`
}

type commentsBody struct {
	Comments []struct {
		Body string `json:"body"`
	} `json:"comments"`
}

// register returns a client for a new user.
func register(t *testing.T, c *webtest.Client, name string) *webtest.Client {
	var u userBody
	c.Post("/api/users", `{"user":{"username":"`+name+`","email":"`+name+`@test.com","password":"password123"}}`).Status(201).JSON(&u)
	return c.WithHeader("Authorization", "Token "+u.User.Token)
}

func TestEditComment(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, (t *testing.T) => {
		a := webtest.Boot(t, config.Load, app.Build)
		webtest.Run(t, a, "db:migrate")
		c := webtest.NewClient(t, a.Kernel)
		ann, bob := register(t, c, "ann"), register(t, c, "bob")

		var art struct {
			Article struct {
				Slug string `json:"slug"`
			} `json:"article"`
		}
		ann.Post("/api/articles", `{"article":{"title":"Edits","description":"d","body":"b"}}`).Status(201).JSON(&art)
		slug := art.Article.Slug
		var created commentBody
		ann.Post("/api/articles/"+slug+"/comments", `{"comment":{"body":"first"}}`).Status(201).JSON(&created)
		path := "/api/articles/" + slug + "/comments/" + f"{created.Comment.ID}"

		time.Sleep(time.Minute)
		var edited commentBody
		ann.Put(path, `{"comment":{"body":"second"}}`).Status(200).JSON(&edited)
		e := edited.Comment
		if e.ID != created.Comment.ID || e.Body != "second" || e.Author.Username != "ann" ||
			!e.CreatedAt.Equal(created.Comment.CreatedAt) || !e.UpdatedAt.After(e.CreatedAt) {
			t.Errorf("edited %+v, created %+v", e, created.Comment)
		}
		var list commentsBody
		c.Get("/api/articles/" + slug + "/comments").Status(200).JSON(&list)
		if len(list.Comments) != 1 || list.Comments[0].Body != "second" {
			t.Errorf("comments %+v", list)
		}

		c.Put(path, `{"comment":{"body":"x"}}`).Status(401).Contains(`"token":["is missing"]`)
		ann.Put(path, `{"comment":{"body":""}}`).Status(422).Contains(`"body":["can't be blank"]`)
		ann.Put("/api/articles/nope/comments/1", `{"comment":{"body":"x"}}`).Status(404).Contains(`"article":["not found"]`)
		ann.Put("/api/articles/"+slug+"/comments/999", `{"comment":{"body":"x"}}`).Status(404).Contains(`"comment":["not found"]`)
		bob.Put(path, `{"comment":{"body":"x"}}`).Status(403).Contains(`"comment":["forbidden"]`)

		time.Sleep(15 * time.Minute) // 16 minutes after the comment was posted
		ann.Put(path, `{"comment":{"body":"third"}}`).Status(409).Contains(`"comment":["can no longer be edited"]`)
		c.Get("/api/articles/" + slug + "/comments").Status(200).Contains(`"body":"second"`)
	})
}
